page.notes: Printed "s" (long s) read as s throughout. Where the scan shows "fi" for "si" (e.g. "si prolabantur", "si qui vero"), I read it as si. Spelling changed from printed v/u to modern rule: "ANTIDOTVS" to "ANTIDOTUS", "vnà" to "unà", "vt" to "ut", "vltra" to "ultra", "gustauerúntque" to "gustaverúntque". The superscript a and b in the text are reference marks; the margin notes are Heb.6.4. and Heb. 10. 26. The errata line is printed in italic and is kept as a foot note.
